document.abstract: Consumer Technology Association’s (CTA’s) contributions to the worldwide library of video standards this past year included documents addressing NextGen TV, high-definition multimedia interface (HDMI) streaming media, energy efficiency, and extended reality (XR). All standards and specifications in this update are available as free downloads at CTA.tech/Standards

authors.bio: Mike Bergman is the vice president of technology and standards at the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), where he leads association work on cyber-security and internet standards.
